title: Remove automatic multi-action bullet splitting feature

requirements.text: Remove all UI elements related to automatic paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion based on internal phrase detection, including any labels, checkboxes, or toggle controls

quotes: Remove any UI label or checkbox related to automatic paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion based on internal phrase detection

acceptanceCriteria: No UI controls visible for multi-action splitting feature
User cannot enable or disable multi-action splitting from the interface

requirements.text: Disable and remove the background logic in frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts that attempts to break a single sentence into multiple bullets without punctuation, including the multi-pass semantic splitting system that detects action phrases in long sentences

quotes: Disable background logic that attempts to break a single sentence into multiple bullets without punctuation

acceptanceCriteria: Each grammatically complete sentence is converted into exactly one bullet point
No automatic splitting of sentences based on action phrase detection
Long sentences remain as single bullets regardless of word count or detected action phrases

requirements.text: Retain and ensure continued functionality of Basic Bullet Formatting, Definition Style Format, and Headings Auto Detect features in the Notes Cleaner

quotes: Retain: - Basic Bullet Formatting - Definition Style Format - Headings Auto Detect

acceptanceCriteria: Basic bullet formatting continues to work

requirements.text: Preserve all existing UI controls including Clean Notes button, Reset Output button, TXT Download button, File Name option, and overall UI layout without modification

quotes: Do not modify: - Clean Notes button - Reset Output button - TXT Download button - File Name option - UI Layout

acceptanceCriteria: All existing buttons remain functional and unchanged
UI layout stays identical to current design
File name customization continues to work

constraints: Do not modify the Clean Notes button functionality
Do not modify the Reset Output button functionality
Do not modify the TXT Download button functionality
Do not modify the File Name option
Do not change the UI layout of the Notes Cleaner page
nonGoals: Implementing advanced semantic splitting (reserved for future AI Advanced Cleaning module)
Adding new features to the Notes Cleaner
Modifying other pages or components outside Notes Cleaner
Changing the styling or appearance of existing UI elements
